lines.rookie: Miri brings water to the college rooms. A man from the office was checking the rooms. So Miri hid Yun Dong-ju's copy in her box, inside the college piano. Her card, signed with a water drop, pointed to keys of black and white. At dawn, the numbers on Yun's list opened the box. Yun gave the copy to his friend. Yun wrote his poems in Korean when Korean was pushed out of the schools. In 1948 they became a book.
lines.junior: Miri, who brings water to the college rooms, hid the copy Yun Dong-ju made for his friend in her own box inside the college piano, because a man from the office was checking the rooms that night. Her card, signed with a water drop, pointed to keys of black and white. At dawn the box opened with the numbers on Yun's list, and Yun handed the copy to his friend. Yun kept writing his poems in Korean while Korean was being pushed out of the schools. In 1948 they became a book.
lines.master: Miri, who brings water to the college rooms, concealed the copy Yun Dong-ju had made for his friend in her own box inside the college piano, since a man from the office was inspecting the rooms that night. Her card, signed with a water drop, pointed to keys of black and white. At dawn the box yielded to the numbers on Yun's list, and Yun entrusted the copy to his friend. Yun went on writing his poems in Korean even as Korean was being pushed out of the schools, and in 1948 they became a book.
